## Description

<!-- Provide a brief description of what this PR does and why it is needed. -->

## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: A new feature
- [ ] `fix`: A bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation only changes
- [ ] `style`: Formatting or cosmetic changes
- [ ] `refactor`: Code restructuring without functional changes
- [ ] `perf`: A performance improvement
- [ ] `test`: Adding or correcting tests
- [ ] `ci`: CI/CD configuration changes
- [ ] `chore`: Maintenance, dependencies, or tooling changes

## Verification & Testing

<!-- Describe what tests were run to verify the changes. -->

- [ ] `yarn typecheck` passes without errors
- [ ] `yarn vitest run` passes all unit tests
- [ ] `yarn lint` / formatting checks pass
- [ ] Verified manually in local runtime environment

## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] Coding rules in `.agents/rules/` are satisfied (zero `any`, structured error codes)
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets or environment credentials are included
